# Boron — calculated thermodynamic functions

<!-- generated-by: sync-thermochemistry.mjs -->

Source: SRC-000512, NIST Chemistry WebBook / Chase (1998), retrieved 2026-10-06. These are calculations from dated fits, not new measurements. Values below are rounded to four decimal places for computational comparison; this is not a statement of physical precision. Uncertainty: UNKNOWN. Basis: **mol B**.

[Full calculation and limits](../0005-Boron-B-Thermochemistry.md) · [Complete 101-point-per-fit CSV](0005-Boron-B-TABLE-010-Thermodynamic-Functions.csv) · [Exact coefficients](../data/structured/0005-Boron-B-NIST-Thermochemistry.yaml)

|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| GAS:01 | UNSPECIFIED-IN-FIT-TABLE | 4137.8950 | 20.8626 | 208.1214 | 79.8432 |
| GAS:01 | UNSPECIFIED-IN-FIT-TABLE | 5068.9475 | 21.1135 | 212.3764 | 99.3678 |

Each row uses only the named phase and fit interval. Do not subtract rows from different phases to obtain transition enthalpy without first resolving their standard-state reference offsets.

sources.organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.scope_note: A species-specific gas retrieval of the existing Boron WebBook work SRC-000064; original electron-affinity/ion-energetics metadata remains byte-identical. Same-work linkage is not independent corroboration.
sources.scope: The exact publisher species is B with InChI=1S/B, not B2, B ions or an equilibrium vapor mixture. One mole of the source species is one mole of B atoms. No molecular factor of two applies. The gas-only response supplies one fit for 4137.895–6000 K. A separate retained condensed-phase diagnostic contains one LIQUID fit and two SOLID fits. Those fits are not imported, relabelled, or bound to the neutral atomic GAS state. No gas evaluation below the source minimum 4137.895 K is justified. The retained source limits do not themselves establish a boiling point, a gas stability boundary or a pressure-dependent phase boundary. Existing B-10/B-11 isotope records and atomic-weight data retain separate scope. No isotope-specific gas properties or numeric isotope abundances are inferred from this elemental fit or its listed molecular weight. The Shomate equations contain no pressure variable. Applied pressure, arbitrary-pressure EOS and phase diagrams are not inferred. Separate source entropy reference-pressure labels belong to those original data only. No B/B2 equilibrium fraction, dimer dissociation, ionisation fraction, charge-state mixture or molecular nuclear-spin population is calculated or assigned. Fit boundaries from separate phases and enthalpy reference offsets are retained as reported and are not a constructed phase-transition path or latent-heat calculation. Coefficient uncertainty and covariance are unreported. Printed-temperature cells, output rounding and numerical derivative residuals are source-format/software checks, not physical uncertainty. Independent transcription arithmetic against publisher values and positive samples within the fit do not establish experimental replication, new calorimetry, complete Boron thermophysics or element completion.
sources.reference: Chase, M.W., Jr. (1998), NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, Fourth Edition. Fit comment: Data last reviewed in June, 1983.
